snippet.title: Gata Guressi • Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3962430/Gata_Guressi/
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/dQaMPNmvGa

Learn to communicate with the people of Hierre by translating their languages and understanding their cultures in this sci-fi translation game. Use your knowledge of history, culture, and the planets to navigate Kallay Tirridor, selling a rare resource to its patrons and uncovering its dark secrets.
